nodes.title: Define the domain model and TypeScript types
nodes.summary: Model the data extracted from the voicenote. TeamMember: id, name, role, responsibilities[], primaryApps[], bio/notes, createdAt. WorkflowNode: id, label, type (actor | system | process | artifact | decision), description, ownerId (optional TeamMember reference), group/lane, position {x, y}. WorkflowEdge: id, source, target, label, kind (data | handoff | trigger). Workflow: id, name, version, nodes[], edges[]. Keep types in one shared module so the DB layer, seed data and UI all agree.

nodes.title: Build the IndexedDB data layer
nodes.summary: Implement a typed persistence module (using the 'idb' wrapper or raw IndexedDB) that opens a versioned database with object stores: 'members' (keyPath id), 'workflows' (keyPath id), plus a 'meta' store for flags such as 'seeded'. Expose async functions: getAllMembers, addMember, updateMember, deleteMember, getWorkflow, saveWorkflow, isSeeded, markSeeded. Include error handling and an onupgradeneeded migration path so future schema changes are safe.

nodes.title: Seed the team members from the voicenote
nodes.summary: Write seed data and a first-load seeding routine that runs only when the 'seeded' flag is absent. Members: Paul (software developer; builds IntentForge and PenEd, runs roadmaps, pushes to GitHub, tests and fixes breaks, issues campaign briefs); Shelly (UI/UX; builds the lightweight UI design shell for the PenEd Tools admin/creator apps and IntentForge client, her design changes trigger roadmap generation, also issues campaign briefs); Dan (finance and operations; builds the Invoice Capture app for supplier invoices, Excel export, job attachment, stock/services and accounting tracking); Bianca (marketing; builds PenEd Marketing, starts campaigns from briefs and manages the milestone hierarchy). Make seeding idempotent and transactional so a refresh or double-mount never duplicates records.

nodes.title: Seed the workflow data mapping the full voicenote flow
nodes.summary: Encode the described process as nodes and edges and seed it in the same first-load routine. Core chain: Roadmap created in IntentForge → AI prompt/response (copy-paste) → project updates saved to server → pushed to GitHub → Paul pulls, runs and tests → if breaks, new roadmap and loop back, else done. PenEd branch: Admin app builds curriculum tree (curriculum → subject → lesson) → AI breaks lessons into outcomes and objectives → Creator app receives lesson → content roadmap with tool schemas → AI returns correctly shaped data → content generated for the LMS. Tool pipeline: Admin describes a new tool → appears as a roadmap in the Creator app → roadmap generates tool files → tool added to PenEdTools → prompt system auto-updates with the new tool schema (feedback loop into content generation) → content displayed via frame. Design branch: Shelly edits the lightweight UI shell → changes converted into one roadmap per affected system (front end, API, etc.) → run in IntentForge → apps updated (PenEd, Invoice Capture, PenEd Marketing). Dan branch: Invoice Capture → invoices to Excel → attached to jobs/accounting. Bianca branch: campaign brief from Shelly or Paul → pasted into PenEd Marketing → roadmap generates hierarchical milestone list. Flag the vague areas from the voicenote (tool suggestion process, Shelly-to-roadmap handoff, Dan's service tracking) as nodes with a 'needs definition' status so they are visible rather than hidden.

nodes.title: Render the workflow as an interactive flow diagram
nodes.summary: Build the Workflow page using React Flow (@xyflow/react). On load, read the workflow from IndexedDB and map nodes/edges to React Flow format. Provide custom node components styled per type (actor, system, process, artifact, decision), labeled and animated edges, swimlane or group backgrounds for IntentForge, PenEd, PenEdTools, Design, Finance and Marketing, plus MiniMap, Controls, zoom/pan and fit-to-view. Show loading and empty/error states while the DB initialises.

nodes.title: Add node details and workflow editing with persistence
nodes.summary: Clicking a node opens a side panel showing its description, owner (linked to a team member), and status. Allow dragging nodes to reposition them and persist the new positions to IndexedDB, with optional add/edit/delete of nodes and edges so the workflow can evolve as the voicenote's vague parts get clarified. Include a 'Reset to seed data' action that clears and reseeds the workflow store after confirmation.

nodes.title: Build the Team page with member cards
nodes.summary: Create the Team page that loads all members from IndexedDB and displays them as cards showing name, role, responsibilities and the apps they own. Add live filtering/sorting, an empty state, and links from each member to the workflow nodes they own (and back from nodes to members) so roles and process stay connected.

nodes.title: Implement the 'Add team member' flow
nodes.summary: Add a button on the Team page that opens a modal form (name, role, responsibilities, apps/ownership, notes) with validation (required name and role, trimmed input, duplicate-name warning). On submit, generate an id, save to the IndexedDB members store, and update the UI immediately without a page reload. Also support editing and deleting members, with confirmation on delete and handling of workflow nodes that referenced the removed member.

nodes.title: Share state and handle async DB lifecycle cleanly
nodes.summary: Introduce a small data provider or hooks layer (useMembers, useWorkflow, with React Context or a lightweight store like Zustand) so both pages read from one source of truth, share a single DB connection, and stay in sync after writes. Run seeding once at app start before rendering routes, guard against React StrictMode double invocation, and surface DB errors (e.g. private-browsing or blocked storage) with a clear message.

nodes.title: Polish the UI, responsiveness and accessibility
nodes.summary: Apply a consistent design system: typography, spacing, color tokens per node type and per team member, responsive layout so the diagram and panels work on tablet and mobile widths, keyboard navigation and focus management in modals and the side panel, ARIA labels, and sufficient colour contrast. Add a legend to the workflow page explaining node and edge types.

nodes.title: Add import/export and a workflow-versioning aid
nodes.summary: Because the voicenote is still vague, add JSON export and import for both workflow and members so the team can iterate, share and back up the data. Store a version number and updatedAt on the workflow and optionally keep a short history of snapshots in IndexedDB so earlier iterations of the process can be compared or restored.

nodes.title: Test, verify and document the project
nodes.summary: Add unit tests for the DB layer and seeding (idempotency, add member, persisted positions) using Vitest with fake-indexeddb, and component tests for the Team form and Workflow page with React Testing Library. Manually verify first-load seeding, refresh persistence, and reset behaviour. Write a README covering setup, scripts, data model, how to extend the seed data, and a list of open questions from the voicenote that still need clarification with the team.
